scope: Native PAPER bootstrap continuation versus strict authorization. No operational launch, provider request, operator model deserialization/activation or new market-performance sample.

diagnosis.native_ordering: Early green-sniper/basic-filter bootstrap gates execute before native risk/cluster enrichment and executable route/price-impact collection. Requiring those unobserved fields at this point prevents otherwise qualified synthetic PAPER candidates from reaching collection.

original_publishing_reproduction.scope: Untouched publishing native bootstrap and AST-executed original run_bot helper, synthetic valid market fields and config, missing cluster/impact/route. No actual provider or runtime.

diagnosis.causality_limit: The reproduced ordering defect is not established as the cause of the retained no-buy smoke: its 19 bootstrap evaluations contained overlapping independent quality failures under a different original configuration. No eligible historical counterfactual or missed profitable trade is established.

readonly_original_context.scope: Original retained runtime event grain and current readonly config/metadata, no model load or operational replay. The latest retained run can be a previous controlled smoke; not a current live market or whole-strategy performance sample.

implementation.provisional_only: Explicit boolean opt-in may defer only absent/None cluster status, route and impact to existing collection stages; malformed, observed negative or unsafe inputs are never deferred.
implementation.unchanged_gates: Known risk, real liquidity, market/score/activity, original age, exact central PAPER size, quotas, pre-entry risk, route collection freshness, final overlay/capacity and original entry-observation/coherence controls remain.
implementation.strict_after_enrichment: Both native post_risk_enrichment and final_execution_guard revalidate with observed-route requirement and no pending-enrichment opt-in. They return before downstream persistence/buy on missing/failed checks.
implementation.telemetry: Native events and token context distinguish provisional continuation/pending checks from completed authorization. Successful strict revalidation clears pending state.
implementation.extreme_signal_scope: Synthetic +500%, +25000% and +1000000% momentum passes both qualified phases unchanged and at exact 0.1 SOL. No artificial 100/200% ceiling in these paths; not executed profit, all-capital retention, best fills or exhaustive opportunity capture.

expanded_focused.scope: Native staged bootstrap guards plus existing entry observation, inference coherence, pre-entry risk and loaded/code integrity suites.

verification.executed_guard_scope: 18 cases execute complete native guard blocks with actual bootstrap logic and inert dependencies/downstream sentinels, including rejection, completion and overlay/capacity veto. Bounded guard execution, not full running-bot/provider acceptance.

full_suites.warnings_scope: Two existing pandas FutureWarnings each at analytics/model_runtime_common.py:487; no failing tests.

working.scope: Cold native imports/config and synthetic input contract only; no fit, runtime start or provider access.

publishing.scope: Cold native imports/config and synthetic input contract only; no fit, runtime start or provider access.

requested_stop.scope: D working checkout only; no publishing stop or runtime launch.

inventory.qualification: Read-only mtime census, not a cryptographic historical preservation proof. Intended stop SQL/log and preflight metrics are excluded.

sql.qualification: Empty scoped green LIVE groups do not prove whole-wallet or profitable full-strategy acceptance.

shutdown.publication_handoff: Fresh post-publication verification is recorded in the private delivery receipt.

tail_regressions.scope: Native synthetic bootstrap/market momentum and exact cash through+1000000%; actual isolated costed PAPER partial executions through+100000%, 3% original quantity retained before later cash drawdown. Not real financial capture or all-capital retention.

preservation: Source-only changes; operator env/data/models/registries/policies/history stay outside publication. Current readonly model alias is absent, distinct from incompatible/rejected model. Train status is inactive metadata, not a runtime probability or profitability proof.
remaining: Operational first-launch/provider and full-strategy independent forward evidence, profitable extreme-tail capture, actual access/latency/depth/fills and other architecture acceptance remain incomplete. Runtime must remain OFF.
